subject: Matemática
description_pt: Ler, escrever e ordenar números naturais até a ordem das centenas de milhar com compreensão das principais características do sistema de numeração decimal.

components.cc_component_description: Read and write multi-digit numbers up to 1,000,000 by moving between number names (word form) and expanded form

components.description_pt: Identificar posições de valor posicional até centenas de milhar no sistema de numeração decimal

cc_matches.description: Look for and make use of structure.

Read and write multi-digit whole numbers using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form. Compare two multi-digit numbers based on meanings of the digits in each place, using >, =, and < symbols to record the results of comparisons.
